why: Ground truth for splitWords, measured by running GLiNER's own WhitespaceTokenSplitter regex under CPython. The offsets are converted from Python's code-point indices to UTF-16 code-unit indices, which is what a JS string index is. Nothing here is derived from src/words.ts.

oracle.note: Every text here is free of code points unassigned at this Unicode version, so no oracle-vs-host version skew is baked in.
